resources.string: Import from Google Authenticator
Import from Google Authenticator
In Google Authenticator
Open the menu and tap Transfer accounts, then Export accounts.
Choose the accounts to move and tap Next. A large export is shown as several QR codes.
Google Authenticator blocks screenshots. If it is on this phone, photograph its codes with another device and choose the photos here.
Scan with camera
Choose QR images
